subject: CFG-1836: which environment drifted on a uniform key
body:
Nora Lindqvist (QA) writing with a quick request. Please audit the shipping-api configs for drift:
find the environment whose copy sets a must-be-uniform key differently from the rest, and name the
key.

Use the uniformity list in config/POLICY.md; the environment-specific keys it allows to vary are not
drift, and the security keys are checked separately.

Regards, Nora Lindqvist -- QA
